test_title: PYST 35: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The sound made by bees
solution:
The correct answer is '**Buzz**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Buzz**'.
 
• It means 'to make the sound that bees, etc. make when flying'. (भिनभिनाना)
 
 
• *Example: A large fly was **buzzing** against the windowpane.*
